newsitem.title: USA: Biogen says European drug patent revoked.
newsitem.headline: Biogen says European drug patent revoked.

text.p: Biogen Inc said Wednesday the European Patent Office had revoked the company's European patent covering the production of recombinant beta interferon as result of an appeal filed by Schering AG of Germany.
Biogen said the Technical Board of Appeal ruled that the patent was not valid on the grounds that the work described in it was obvious and therefore lacked an inventive step.
The company said the decision of the Patent Office is final and cannot be appealed.
However, it said the decision will not affect its ability to sell its AVONEX product (Interferon beta-1a) in any market, including Europe.
It also said it believes its patents issued or pending in other major markets will not be affected.

The European Commission approved AVONEX as a treatment for relapsing multiple sclerosis in European Union member countries last month. The product has been available in the United States since May 1996.
Biogen shares were down 2-1/4 at 37 at midday.
